page.layout: One column of running text, centred numbered sections (LXIV to LXIX) with no margin notes. Catchword at the bottom right. No running head or page number printed.

main_text.l: LXIV.
Ex quorum theoria, practicantium Regulæ exoriun-
tur tum plurimæ, tum pulcherrimæ, quæ usum eximium
habent; & quarum etiam compendia miris modis posset
variari.
LXV.
Principia verò & universalia totius scientiæ Geome-
trica perfectissimè docuisse videtur Euclides, XV. suæ
Geometriæ Elementorum libris comprehensa, nudè ἐξ ἀ-
φαιρέσεως[?], Mathematico more, sine ulla materia determi-nata.
LXVI.
Finem illius hunc esse tuemur; naturam, affectiones o-
mnes, proprietates, deniq; discrimina, comparationes, &
quæcunq; tandem Magnitudinibus proprie inhærent, per-
specta habere.
LXVII.
Punctum verò, Σημεῖον ἄμερες[?], ut omnis Magnitudi-
nis exsurgentis est principium; ita eiusdemp. specierum,
Lineæ, Superficiei, & Corporis effectiuũ quoq; merito exi-
stit: pro quarum diuersitate, Geometriæ eximiè, partis no-
bilissimæ, tres constituuntur; simplicis Geometriæ, simplicis
Geodæsiæ, simplicis Stereometriæ: in quibus singulis
principia, varia alia commensurandi, & ponderum,
summa & admirabili artis compendio, struuntur.
LXIIX.
In determinato verò genere hæc eadem cōsyderata, di-
uinum p.usum & fructum earundem demonstrant. MU-
SICA enim numerum ad sonos demum reuocauit, in ys-
demq;[?] secundùm ἄρσιν & θέσιν harmoniam adinvenit,
Canticaq; constituit.
LXIX.
Radÿ verò ceu lineæ Visuales, OPTICAE; Reflexæ,
CATOPTRICAE; ab Axe denig; Mundi dependentes.

page.notes: Numbered sections are printed as bare numerals on their own lines, so they are given as separate paragraphs. "LXIIX." is printed as such (a printing error for LXVIII) and is left as printed. Doubtful readings: the Greek in LXV (ἀ-φαιρέσεως, line-broken) and LXVII (Σημεῖον ἄμερες), the form "ys-demq;" in LXVIII, and the abbreviation "denig;" in LXIX, where it may be "deniq;". Greek θέσιν is a faint print and may need checking.
